releaseNotes:
Consolidated updates from 1.17.122 to 1.17.132.

### Ticketek

#### New features

- Continuous automatic recovery with 15-second retries, no attempt limit and activity-log updates.
- Fixed/Random Range refresh options across all monitoring setup modes.

#### Fixes and improvements

- Fixed selected categories losing their identity after refresh or catalogue updates.
- Improved expired/0:00 timer recovery and reopening of selection controls.
- Fixed Choose your own availability capture and duplicate category-ID matching.
- Preserved Stop, held-ticket/checkout protection and waiting-room handling.

### AXS Australia

#### New features

- Ticket Review details with account display excluded from copied details.
- Confirmation Clipper and event-detail exports.
- EZ Filter price-band, ticket-type and VIP-package options.
- Cookie clearing with confirmation and safety checks.

#### Fixes and improvements

- Fixed empty popup content and filter Apply failures.
- Supports AXS whole-dollar price rounding.
- Larger text, compact options and simplified Sold out labels.

### Ticketmaster / Ticketek Marketplace

- No platform-specific changes recorded in this version range.
